scope: Papers and official code relevant to ROADWATCH phone-use, driver-action, temporal localization, small-object and seatbelt branches

roadwatch_reference.event_run: V26 E2 cached D5 development diagnostic
roadwatch_reference.warning: Twenty events from two repeatedly inspected development subjects; not independent holdout evidence.

studies.paper: DMD: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Driver Monitoring Dataset for Attention and Alertness Analysis
studies.reported_metric: 92.0% test Top-1, RGB MobileNetV2 MaxP-MLP, four segments
studies.reason: Same source domain and action semantics, but no untrimmed event P/R/F1 or phone association.

studies.paper: Vision-Language Models can Identify Distracted Driver Behavior from Naturalistic Videos
studies.reported_metric: 98.44% DMD VideoCLIP Top-1 at 1 FPS with held-out driver sets; 93.39% Multi-frameCLIP; 82.65% Single-frameCLIP; 48.12% zero-shot
studies.reason: Strong candidate representation, but headline score is not zero-shot and not event F1.

studies.paper: DualScope: Capturing Critical Spatial and Temporal Cues for Distracted Driving Activity Recognition
studies.task: video action classification with behavior-centric spatial and multi-scale temporal modeling
studies.reason: Architecture addresses lost local detail and redundant frames, but source code link is unavailable and metric is Top-1.

studies.paper: M2DAR: Multi-View Multi-Scale Driver Action Recognition with Vision Transformer
studies.reported_metric: 0.5921 average activity overlap on AI City A2 test
studies.task: multi-view action recognition and localization in untrimmed video
studies.protocol_note: class match plus start/end each within 10 seconds, then temporal overlap
studies.reason: Closest pipeline shape to ROADWATCH; also shows untrimmed localization is much harder than clip accuracy.

studies.paper: ActionFormer: Localizing Moments of Actions with Transformers
studies.reported_metric: 71.0% mAP at tIoU 0.5 on THUMOS14; 36.56% average mAP on ActivityNet 1.3
studies.reason: Useful replacement for hand-built boundary logic after feature/label preparation; published score is not a driver-phone F1.

studies.paper: Slicing Aided Hyper Inference and Fine-tuning for Small Object Detection
studies.reported_metric: inference-only AP gains of 6.8/5.1/5.3 points for FCOS/VFNet/TOOD; cumulative 12.7/13.4/14.5 with sliced fine-tuning
studies.reason: Phone is small in cabin frames, but gains must be remeasured on phone bbox GT and may increase latency/duplicate boxes.

studies.paper: Zero-Shot Distracted Driver Detection via Vision Language Models with Double Decoupling
studies.reported_metric: 76.0% SAM-DD multiclass Top-1 for full method; binary safe-vs-distracted AUPRC 95.8%
studies.reason: Demonstrates that a >95 binary AUPRC can coexist with <85 multiclass Top-1; exports classwise metrics and predictions.

studies.paper: Seatbelt Detection Algorithm Improved with Lightweight Approach and Attention Mechanism
studies.reported_metric: 98.25% reported binary seatbelt accuracy/F1 on a self-built dataset
studies.task: windshield localization followed by binary seatbelt classification
studies.reason: ROADWATCH includes uncertain_or_occluded and an in-cabin domain; binary headline cannot replace its three-class gate.
